title: Pivot Escape From a Trap
description: A ball handler is trapped by two defenders in a corner and must use quick, low pivots to find a passing angle out, without picking up a travel.

content.objective: Keep a legal, planted pivot foot while pivoting to find a safe passing angle out of a trap.
content.setup: A ball handler is trapped in the corner by two defenders closing in from both angles.
instructions: On the catch, immediately plant one foot as the pivot foot and keep it down.
Pivot low, scanning for an open outlet rather than panicking.
Pass as soon as a safe angle opens, protecting the ball through the pivot.
Rotate which two players apply the trap each round.
coachingPoints: Plant the pivot foot immediately — deciding late causes travels.
Keep the ball high and away from both defenders' reach.
Stay calm; rushing the pass under pressure causes turnovers.
commonMistakes: Lifting the pivot foot while still deciding where to pass.
Panicking and throwing a pass without checking the outlet is actually open.
Standing up tall instead of staying low through the movement.
content.safety: Defenders trap with hands up, no grabbing the ball handler.
